replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used a calculator app to solve equations and check work. It helped me verify results quickly but didn’t replace my understanding. I prefer hands-on practice over automated answers, which aligns with my practical learning style.

First, take the derivative f’(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are potential stationary points. Plug them back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values. Check if they’re maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
